content.simple_explanation: 'Grandmother’s Quilt' is studied by first understanding the main idea, then noticing the evidence, examples and relationships in the chapter.
study_steps: Explain them in your own words.
key_points: Grandmother’s Quilt ChapterChapter 1111 Preetha and Adrit’s grandmother made a quilt cover using old clothes.
Tick the lace option that would cover the entire border of the quilt.
She decides to use two different coloured laces.
How much lace of each kind will be needed to cover the entire border?
Recall that the length of the border of a shape is called its perimeter.
